name: Dyna Comp

dims.source: preset mxr_standard 60 x 111 x 32 mm bare enclosure (parts.js PRESETS, high confidence); same MXR standard box as Phase 90. See references/mxr-dyna-comp_measurements.md.

knobs.note: OUTPUT left knob. Photo-derived from references/mxr-dyna-comp_main.jpg (see measurements.md); pointer at 12 o'clock in reference.
SENSITIVITY right knob. Photo-derived, mirror of OUTPUT; pointer at 12 o'clock.

led.note: Centered red LED between MXR logo and footswitch (main + left side views).

footswitch.note: Round chrome stomp switch, centered (main + both side views).

jacks.note: INPUT on right wall. Print confirmed in main; z from main + right side views.
OUTPUT on left wall (left side view carries this jack alone).

sidePowerJack.note: Proposed spec field (parts.js powerJack() only mounts on the back wall; the M102 9V barrel is on the right wall front of the INPUT jack, right side view, provisional ±0.1 in). The hero page renders it from this field; board integration needs the proposed parts.js side-power support in the build report.

sideSticker.note: White CE / 9V polarity sticker on the front half of the right wall (right side view, provisional). Rendered by the hero page; not deck print.

labels.note: Block MXR logo inside the decal rounded-rect border (main).
Vertical INPUT print on top edge by right jack (main).
Vertical OUTPUT print on top edge by left jack (main).

notes: MXR Dyna Comp (M102) hero, detailed standalone for later board adaptation. Bare-enclosure dims from parts.js PRESETS.mxr_standard (60x111x32mm, high). Two knobs (OUTPUT/SENSITIVITY) + LED + round footswitch; no treadle. Coordinates: back=-z (knob side), front=+z (dyna comp text). All deck parts seat via surfaceAt() (flat deck h=1.26) — no hardcoded y on knobs/LED/switch. MXR badge border and the dyna comp lettering are baked into textures/mxr-dyna-comp-decal.png so the letterforms render identically on every platform; OUTPUT/SENSITIVITY/MXR/INPUT/OUTPUT remain vector textLabels. Power jack is on the right side wall on the real pedal: carried as sidePowerJack (powerJack null) because parts.js powerJack() is back-wall only; the hero page renders the side jack from the spec. Positions photo-derived from references/mxr-dyna-comp_measurements.md; side power/sticker values provisional (single view).
